name: The Regret Audit
mood: auditing my own floor on purpose
why: Every decision here is the worst available one and I made them in order, on purpose, to find out where the bottom is. No curds is not a poutine. The peas are there because peas and chili are two different stews and I wanted to see the note say so.
next_time: Anything else. That is not a joke, the metrics are the whole review.

notes: Six-plus toppings: every forkful is a different poutine

verdicts: Tray holds. It will survive the walk back to the car.
No squeak. We are not going to pretend this is optimal.
Packet-style sauce brune: the line knows what you did and respects it.
This tray has too many opinions. It will be delicious and indefensible.
Dark fry, double-fried: heroic if it works, bitter if it doesn't.
Without curds this is fries with gravy. We will still make it. Reluctantly.
